text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was taking good care of my skin, though...
Is it the cream? Or maybe stress—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aha! Could these kinds of worries lead to stress...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait... Are you stressed because of a breakout...?
Or did you break out because you're stressed...? Huh, which was it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I don't know... but!
I can't overthink this! Don't overthink it, don't overthink it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle ended up being troubled
by rough skin.
